chunks: What Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Ribʿi ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
My father’s litter stumbled between ʿArafah and al-Muzdalifah, so he dismounted and prayed al-maghrib, and he prayed the later ʿisha prayer at al-Muzdalifah.

key_terms.الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ: the night prayer, meaning the later evening salat
key_terms.الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ: al-Muzdalifah, the place where pilgrims proceed after ʿArafah
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: ʿArafah, the hajj station before proceeding to al-Muzdalifah
key_terms.مَحْمِلُ: the litter or riding carriage being used for travel

ai.seo_question: Can al-maghrib prayer be performed at ʿArafat on the night of sacrifice, or must it be delayed until al-Muzdalifah?
ai.summary: This hadith relates an incident concerning the timing and place of al-maghrib and al-ʿisha prayers on the night of sacrifice during hajj. It indicates the performance of the prayers in connection with reaching al-Muzdalifah, and is used in the jurisprudential discussion that al-maghrib is not to be prayed at ʿArafat on that night.
